parameters.query:
SELECT 
    s.*, 
    c.name AS category_name,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM service_catalog s 
LEFT JOIN miscellaneous_categories c ON s.category_id = c.id
WHERE 
    s.is_sales = $1
    AND (
        $2 IS NULL
        OR $2 = ''
        OR unaccent(s.name) ILIKE unaccent('%' || $2 || '%')
    )
    AND (
        $5::boolean IS NULL
        OR COALESCE(s.is_active, true) = $5::boolean
    )
    -- is_lab (script 167): 'true' / 'false' filtran; ausente o vacío = todos.
    AND (
        $6::text IS NULL
        OR $6::text NOT IN ('true', 'false')
        OR COALESCE(s.is_lab, false) = ($6::text = 'true')
    )
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
LIMIT $3
OFFSET (($4 - 1) * $3);

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    s.*, 
    c.name AS category_name
FROM service_catalog s 
LEFT JOIN miscellaneous_categories c ON s.category_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = $1

-- Sólo el subconjunto que la clínica publicó para auto-agenda. El catálogo
-- entero NO es ofrecible al paciente: una cirugía existe como servicio pero
-- nadie la reserva solo desde una landing.
--
-- `show_pricing` viaja con cada fila para que el nodo siguiente decida si
-- incluye los precios: si la clínica eligió no mostrarlos, tampoco tienen que
-- salir por un endpoint sin token.
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.description,
    COALESCE(s.duration_minutes, 0) AS duration_minutes,
    s.price,
    s.currency,
    s.image_updated_at::text        AS image_updated_at,
    -- Fuente de verdad de "tiene imagen": el archivo en Drive. La UI usa esto
    -- para no pedir una imagen que no existe.
    (s.image_drive_file_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_image,
    (
      SELECT COALESCE(c.patient_portal_show_pricing, FALSE)
      FROM public.clinic c
      WHERE c.is_active IS NOT FALSE
      ORDER BY c.id
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS show_pricing
FROM public.service_catalog s
WHERE s.bookable_online IS TRUE
  AND s.is_active IS NOT FALSE
  AND s.is_sales IS NOT FALSE
ORDER BY s.name

UPDATE public.service_catalog
SET image_filename      = NULL,
    image_mimetype      = NULL,
    image_drive_file_id = NULL,
    image_web_view_link = NULL,
    image_updated_at    = NULL
WHERE id = $1::integer
RETURNING id::text AS id,
          image_drive_file_id AS previous_drive_file_id

SELECT image_drive_file_id,
       image_mimetype
FROM public.service_catalog
WHERE id = $1::integer
  AND is_active IS NOT FALSE

SELECT image_drive_file_id
FROM public.service_catalog
WHERE id = $1::integer

UPDATE public.service_catalog
SET image_filename      = $2,
    image_mimetype      = $3,
    image_drive_file_id = $4,
    image_web_view_link = $5,
    image_updated_at    = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::integer
RETURNING id::text AS id,
          image_filename,
          image_mimetype,
          image_drive_file_id,
          image_updated_at::text AS image_updated_at
